text:
Adam in Paradise, you in a garden; he placed in honor, you in agony; he sleeps and poorly watches his companion; yours sleep while you pray awake.


He committed the first disorder; you restored our first day; you drink the cup your Father sends, while he eats disobedience and lives dead.


The sweat of his face sustains him; yours sustains our glory; his was the guilt, yours the disgrace.


He left error, you leave remembrance; that was blind deceit, this redemption. How differently you leave our story!

translation.title: Adam in Paradise, You in a Garden
